source.publisher: South African Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation — official MDB2020 spatial layer
source.section: Wards (MDB2020) layer (23) — EPSG:4326 point-intersection query for the canonical Vanderbijlpark-auidwes Lokasie point returned Gauteng, Emfuleni Local Municipality (GT421), Ward 4 (GT421_4)
source.licence_note: Official ward boundary service used for an identity-specific spatial parent assertion; no boundary geometry is copied.

supporting_sources.section: Emfuleni Local Municipality GT421 Ward 4 map — the ward map identifies Vanderbijlpark and its southwest/east residential subdivisions, including Vanderbijlpark SW 5
Consolidated SDF Report, section 2.4.2 Vanderbijlpark — identifies SW 5 as a Vanderbijlpark suburb and describes Vanderbijlpark as a town
Geographic locations — identifies Vanderbijlpark and Vereeniging as Emfuleni's two main town centers

identity_note: The canonical Vanderbijlpark-auidwes Lokasie identity is retained exactly. The parent edge uses its identity-specific point intersecting official Emfuleni Ward 4 and the official municipal/ward-map Vanderbijlpark town context; the source display name is not used as a standalone geography fallback.
